movies.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movies.description: Just dropped and breaking records — Tom Holland's wildest Spidey ride yet
movies.overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

movies.title: Coyote vs. Acme
movies.description: The un-shelved masterpiece everyone fought for — pure slapstick brilliance and heart
movies.overview: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

movies.title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
movies.description: The Avatar fandom is exploding — stunning animation and emotional perfection
movies.overview: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands and threatens to upend the peace they sacrificed everything to achieve.

movies.title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
movies.description: Letterboxd is losing its mind over this queer slasher fever dream
movies.overview: An ambitious director sets out to revive a faded slasher franchise, but her meeting with the film’s reclusive original star spirals into a terrifying maze of obsession, fear, and blood-soaked delusion.

movies.title: Tony
movies.description: Dominic Sessa shines in A24's sharpest, most talked-about indie comedy
movies.overview: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

movies.title: The Love Hypothesis
movies.description: BookTok's favorite romance finally arrived and the chemistry is completely off the charts
movies.overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

movies.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle
movies.description: Pure cinematic adrenaline — the most jaw-dropping animation spectacle of the year
movies.overview: The Demon Slayer Corps are drawn into the Infinity Castle, where Tanjiro, Nezuko, and the Hashira face terrifying Upper Rank demons in a desperate fight as the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji begins.

movies.title: The Furious
movies.description: Action cinema at its peak — brutal, relentless martial arts mastery
movies.overview: After a criminal network kidnaps Wang Wei's daughter and the corrupt police refuse to assist him, Wei sets out on his own to locate her. Navin, a tenacious journalist whose wife has mysteriously vanished, is his only ally. In this explosive martial arts showdown, the unlikely duo fights the kidnappers ruthlessly driven by a furious vengeance.

movies.title: Don't Say Good Luck
movies.description: Heartwarming, funny, and deeply touching — Julia Hart delivers a crowd-pleasing gem
movies.overview: Sophie Birenbaum is ready for the spotlight as the lead in her high school musical — until she's suddenly facing more drama at home than on the stage.

movies.title: Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall
movies.description: Dark, faithful, and intense — DC animation delivers the ultimate Batman tragedy
movies.overview: Arkham Asylum has been destroyed, and all its inmates have been unleashed upon Gotham City. As Batman races to round up some of his greatest enemies, he is pushed to his physical and mental limits and into a final confrontation with a new threat: the man called Bane!

movies.title: The End of Oak Street
movies.description: Anne Hathaway and Ewan McGregor in a mind-bending sci-fi mystery everyone is dissecting
movies.overview: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

movies.title: The Rivals of Amziah King
movies.description: Matthew McConaughey at his grittiest in this hypnotic southern crime saga
movies.overview: Deep within the backwoods of rural Oklahoma, charismatic and musically gifted Amziah King herds a bluegrass-playing band of misfits while overseeing the premier honey-making operation in town. When Amziah’s estranged foster daughter unexpectedly returns, Amziah leaps at the possibility to renew connection and create a family business. But the honey game is ruthless, and Amziah’s rivals threaten to destroy everything he has built.

movies.title: One Last Shot
movies.description: Scott Adkins delivers nonstop tactical combat in this high-octane thrill ride
movies.overview: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network.

movies.title: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
movies.description: A roaring prehistoric adventure the whole family will want to repeat
movies.overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

movies.title: The Uprising
movies.description: Andrew Garfield leads an intense, visceral historical battle for survival
movies.overview: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.

movies.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
movies.description: Brand new scares in theaters and streams — terrifies from start to finish
movies.overview: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. When something evil comes after her, Gemma discovers an ability that changes everything: she doesn't just enter The Further, she can bring what lives there back to the real world. Once the demons realize her power, our world becomes their playground.

movies.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
movies.description: Sweaty-palms tension returns — don't look down in this dizzying sequel
movies.overview: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

movies.title: Obsession
movies.description: The viral horror sensation of the summer that internet sleuths cannot stop rewatching
movies.overview: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

movies.title: Toy Story 5
movies.description: Emotional, nostalgic, and hilarious — Pixar delivers an unexpected triumph
movies.overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

movies.title: The Invite
movies.description: Olivia Wilde and Seth Rogen ignite sharp laughs in this chaotic dinner party
movies.overview: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?

movies.title: UNABOMBER
movies.description: Russell Crowe commands the screen in this chilling manhunt thriller
movies.overview: Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.

movies.title: The Sheep Detectives
movies.description: Hugh Jackman leads a witty, surprisingly clever mystery full of charm
movies.overview: George Hardy is a shepherd who reads detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can't possibly understand. But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realize they must become the detectives. As they follow the clues and investigate human suspects, they prove that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

movies.title: Tuner
movies.description: Leo Woodall and Dustin Hoffman shine in this sleek, suspenseful crime caper
movies.overview: A gifted piano tuner's meticulous skills for tuning pianos lead him to discover an unexpected aptitude for cracking safes, turning his life upside down.

movies.title: The Debt Collector
movies.description: Hard-hitting martial arts and unrelenting grit make this a must-watch actioner
movies.overview: Tormented by past mistakes and a terminal diagnosis, an ex-debt collector returns to the underworld to protect the victims of a violent organization.

movies.title: Call My Agent! The Movie
movies.description: The beloved French comedy returns with effortless charisma and behind-the-scenes drama
movies.overview: Five years after ASK Agency closed, debut director Andréa loses her lead actor just days before filming and reunited with her old team — for better or worse.

movies.title: Leviticus
movies.description: Haunting, poetic folk horror that crawls directly under your skin
movies.overview: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most:  each other.

movies.title: Pressure
movies.description: Andrew Scott and Brendan Fraser bring pulse-pounding intensity to wartime history
movies.overview: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

movies.title: Voicemails for Isabelle
movies.description: A bittersweet modern romance that nails the messy reality of modern dating
movies.overview: A young woman's hilariously confessional voicemails to her late sister are unknowingly redirected to a stranger, who begins to fall in love from afar.

movies.title: Heartstopper Forever
movies.description: Heartwarming and poignant — the beloved saga concludes on a high note
movies.overview: It's a new school year for the Truham-Higgs gang. As Nick and Charlie's relationship deepens, their thoughts turn to life after the last bell rings.

movies.title: Backrooms
movies.description: Kane Parsons turns internet creepypasta lore into an A24 atmospheric nightmare
movies.overview: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.

movies.title: Exit 8
movies.description: The endless underground corridor mystery keeps viewers guessing until the final twist
movies.overview: A man trapped in an endless sterile subway passageway sets out to find Exit 8. The rules of his quest are simple: do not overlook anything out of the ordinary. If you discover an anomaly, turn back immediately. If you don’t, carry on. Then leave from Exit 8. But even a single oversight will send him back to the beginning. Will he ever reach his goal and escape this infinite corridor?

movies.title: Minions & Monsters
movies.description: Pure chaotic animated fun packed with monstrous laughs and bright spectacle
movies.overview: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

movies.title: Mayday
movies.description: Ryan Reynolds delivers his signature wit in a sky-high action romp
movies.overview: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.

movies.title: I Want Your Sex
movies.description: Gregg Araki delivers his signature wild, subversive comedy with wicked charm
movies.overview: When a naive young man becomes the sexual muse for a renowned and provocative artist, his dream job quickly turns dangerous as he is drawn into an obsessive world of power, betrayal, and murder.

movies.title: Fuze
movies.description: Aaron Taylor-Johnson anchors an explosive, ticking-clock London heist
movies.overview: An unexploded WWII bomb is discovered on a busy construction site in the centre of London. Chaos ensues as the military and police begin a mass evacuation against a ticking clock.

movies.title: Mutiny
movies.description: Jason Statham kicking ass at sea — exactly what action fans crave
movies.overview: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

movies.title: Moana
movies.description: The internet is fiercely divided, but Dwayne Johnson brings the spectacle
movies.overview: Teenage Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

movies.title: One Night Only
movies.description: Sparkling banter and electric chemistry power this feel-good romantic comedy
movies.overview: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

movies.title: Drawn Together
movies.description: Ester Expósito smolders in a sleek, twisty romance steeped in intrigue
movies.overview: Marfil, daughter of a powerful Spanish businessman, sees her life in New York turned upside down when she is kidnapped and released without explanation. Her father hires Sebastian Moore as bodyguard and, forced to spend every minute together, an inevitable attraction ignites in a world where nothing is as it seems.

movies.title: Descendants: Wicked Wonderland
movies.description: Catchy musical numbers and vibrant villainy make for effortless family viewing
movies.overview: Now that the Queen of Hearts is nice and Cinderella is safe, things seem perfect for Red and Chloe… But little do they know that changing the past created a new villain — Maddox Hatter. When Maddox captures the Queen of Hearts, Red and Chloe must work alongside Red’s new sister Pink, Luisa Madrigal’s son Luis, and Maddox’s son Max to save her and Wonderland.

movies.title: Husbands in Action
movies.description: A riotous blend of buddy-cop thrills and slapstick domestic chaos
movies.overview: A detective teams up with his ex-wife's new husband to chase down her kidnappers. Can this unlikely duo put aside their differences for one wild rescue?

movies.title: Power Ballad
movies.description: Paul Rudd charms in this heartfelt musical journey about second chances
movies.overview: When Rick, a past-his-prime wedding singer, meets fading boy-band star Danny during a gig, the two bond over music and a late-night jam session. But when Danny turns one of Rick’s songs into the hit that reignites his career, Rick sets out to reclaim the recognition he believes he deserves - even if it means risking everything he cares about.

movies.title: I Love Boosters
movies.description: Boots Riley delivers a fearless, stylish, and biting satirical heist comedy
movies.overview: A group of shoplifters take aim at a cutthroat fashion maven by stealing from her stores and reselling them at a lower price — what they call 'fashion-forward philanthropy'.
production_companies: The Sun Exploding Words, Sounds, & Pictures

movies.title: Disclosure Day
movies.description: Steven Spielberg and Emily Blunt craft an awe-inspiring sci-fi mystery
movies.overview: A cybersecurity expert becomes a whistleblower after uncovering secrets about aliens, putting him on the run from a corporation. Meanwhile, a meteorologist experiencing strange phenomena joins forces with him to prove there's life beyond our understanding.

movies.title: Maternal Instinct
movies.description: A gripping, heartbreaking true crime documentary exploring the deepest maternal mysteries
movies.overview: Police pull over a woman who claims she just gave birth. But the baby — and the blood — aren't hers. Twisted lies unravel in this true-crime documentary.

movies.title: Facing El Chapo
movies.description: A raw, pulse-pounding glimpse into Mexico's high-stakes cartel world
movies.overview: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.

movies.title: Elize: Shadows of a Woman
movies.description: A dark psychological dissection of murder, betrayal, and high society
movies.overview: In this retelling of a real case, a former escort discovers her wealthy husband's infidelity and struggles to cope as betrayal poisons their marriage.

movies.title: Jackass: Best and Last
movies.description: The final round of painful laughs and legendary stunts from the Jackass crew
movies.overview: The fifth and final installment to Jackass franchise where the crew go on one last insane crusade.

movies.title: Blades of the Guardians
movies.description: Yuen Woo-ping orchestrates breathtaking historical swordplay and dynamic set pieces
movies.overview: Dao Ma, the "second most wanted fugitive," is entrusted by his benefactor, the chief of Mo family clan, to take on a mysterious escort mission-escorting the "most wanted fugitive" to Chang'an.

movies.title: The Little Sister
movies.description: Delicate and moving coming-of-age drama that earned raves on the festival circuit
movies.overview: When Fatima leaves her close-knit suburban family to study philosophy in Paris, she finds herself caught between her religious upbringing and the freedom of student life in the city.

movies.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2
movies.description: Miranda Priestly's return sparked endless memes and glamorous runway fireworks
movies.overview: Andy Sachs returns to Runway as Miranda Priestly navigates a new media landscape and Runway's position within. The duo reconnect with former assistant Emily Charlton, now the head of a luxury brand that possesses funding which could ensure Runway's survival.

movies.title: Camp Rock 3
movies.description: Nostalgic Disney pop energy gets a fresh reboot for a new generation
movies.overview: When pop group Connect 3 returns to Camp Rock to search for an opening act for their reunion tour, rising tensions and fierce competition among campers test old friendships and spark unexpected romances.

movies.title: The Most Precious of Cargoes
movies.description: Michel Hazanavicius crafts an exquisitely illustrated fable of wartime compassion
movies.overview: Once upon a time, a poor woodcutter and his wife lived in a great forest. Cold, hunger, poverty, and a war raging all around them meant their lives were very hard.  One day, the woodcutter's wife rescues a baby. A baby girl thrown from one of the many trains that constantly pass through the forest. This baby, this "most precious of cargoes", will transform the lives of the poor woodcutter's wife and her husband, as well as those whose paths the child will cross—including the man who threw her from the train. And some will try to protect her, whatever the cost. Their story will reveal the worst and the best in the hearts of men.

movies.title: Saccharine
movies.description: A stylish, unsettling body horror that lingers long after credits roll
movies.overview: After succumbing to an obscure weight-loss craze involving the eating of human ashes, lovelorn medical student Hana finds herself haunted by the ghost of the person she's eating.

movies.title: Your Fault: London
movies.description: Melodramatic, soapy British romance made strictly for unapologetic genre fans
movies.overview: Nick and Noah are both embarking on life-changing adventures that are threatening to pull them apart—Nick in business with his father and Noah starting a fresh chapter at Oxford University. Now living separate lives, and meeting new people, they find themselves entangled in temptations, rivalries, and betrayals and their bond is tested like never before. As secrets unravel and temptation rises, they must fight to hold onto each other—or risk losing everything.

movies.title: Beast Race
movies.description: Fernando Meirelles directs an adrenaline-drenched dystopian street race
movies.overview: In future Rio de Janeiro, a young leader of the resistance must enter a deadly parkour-inspired competition in order to save his sister's life.

movies.title: Evil Dead Burn
movies.description: Gory, claustrophobic Deadite mayhem designed for true horror purists
movies.overview: After her husband's abrupt death, Alice seeks solace with his remaining family — descendants of a leading researcher on demonic possession. As her in-laws transform one by one into creatures that feed on fear, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life survive even in death.

movies.title: Borgo
movies.description: A tense Corsican prison drama anchored by an incredible lead performance
movies.overview: Melissa is an experienced, exemplary prison guard. But a dangerous spiral is set into motion when she transfers to a Corsican jail, where she accepts help and protection from inmate Saveriu to get her bearings. Upon his release, he contacts Melissa expecting to collect.

movies.title: The Dink
movies.description: Jake Johnson brings goofy warmth to this breezy, pickleball-obsessed indie comedy
movies.overview: Desperate to save a struggling country club and earn his father's respect, a washed-up tennis pro is compelled to break a sacred vow and do the unthinkable: play pickleball.

movies.title: Desire
movies.description: Sensual and dangerous — a twisted psychological drama steeped in deception
movies.overview: Lucero’s life appears immaculate: a wealthy household, a devoted husband, and two children who embody the promise of a perfect family. Yet beneath this surface simmers a quiet dissatisfaction. When Matías, a young swimming coach hired by her husband, enters their lives, Lucero finds herself pulled into a risky and consuming relationship. As secrecy, desire, and jealousy tighten their grip, the boundaries within the family begin to collapse, placing mother and daughter in a dangerous emotional triangle that threatens to shatter everything Lucero has built.
